verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships several built-in automated behaviors that react to calendar events, such as auto-rescheduling lower-priority events when overbooked, auto-adding buffers, travel, and decompression time around events, and Habits or Focus Time goals that adapt scheduling, which functions as event-triggered automation, and it exposes an MCP endpoint for programmatic access. However, these are preset, template-style automations rather than a general-purpose custom rule engine where users define arbitrary trigger conditions and actions. Missing for 10: user-configurable custom trigger and action rule builder beyond the fixed feature set, independent verification of the MCP endpoint automation capabilities, and evidence of arbitrary event types triggering arbitrary actions.
